budget-project-start-date-missing.message: The project has no start date, so PMO cannot tell which fiscal year this budget belongs to.
budget-project-start-date-missing.remedy: Set the project start and end dates, then retry the push.

budget-fiscal-year-unresolved.message: No ERPNext fiscal year contains the project start or end date.
budget-fiscal-year-unresolved.remedy: Add the missing fiscal year in ERPNext, or correct the project dates, then retry the push.

budget-fiscal-year-ambiguous.message: More than one ERPNext fiscal year contains the project start date, so PMO will not pick one.
budget-fiscal-year-ambiguous.remedy: Remove the overlap between the fiscal years in ERPNext, then retry the push.

budget-multi-fiscal-year-unphased.message: The project spans more than one fiscal year but some budget lines have no fiscal year.
budget-multi-fiscal-year-unphased.remedy: Set a fiscal year on every budget line (or shorten the project dates to one year), then activate again.

outbox-finalize-refused.message: ERPNext accepted the budget, but PMO could not record its reference after several tries.
outbox-finalize-refused.remedy: Retrying repeats the same refusal. Ask an administrator to check the ERPNext connection and the budget's saved reference.

budget-archive-cancellation-held.message: Nothing was sent for this budget yet: an earlier ERPNext budget cancellation for the project still needs a person, or the person who activated this version can no longer be identified.
budget-archive-cancellation-held.remedy: Resolve the previous version's budget in ERPNext, then retry the push.

budget-archive-resume-actor-unauthorized.message: Nothing was sent for this budget: the person recorded as having activated this version is no longer allowed to push budgets to ERPNext. The earlier cancellation is not the problem.
budget-archive-resume-actor-unauthorized.remedy: Restore that person's access, or have an Admin or Finance user retry the push.
